about_short_description.short_description: TAQA provides energy and water to communities around the world.

product.name: Power Generation
product.description: TAQA operates power generation facilities with a total capacity of 23 GW, including renewable energy sources contributing 1.4 GW.

product.name: Water Distribution
product.description: TAQA manages water distribution networks, including 21 kilometers of pipelines, meeting 95% of Abu Dhabi's water needs.

product.name: Transmission & Distribution
product.description: TAQA oversees electricity transmission and distribution networks, covering 90 kilometers, ensuring reliable power supply.

product.name: Renewable Energy
product.description: TAQA is involved in renewable energy projects, aiming for renewables to account for 65% of its power generation capacity by 2030.

product.name: Oil & Gas
product.description: TAQA engages in oil and gas operations, including exploration, production, and asset management across various regions.

product.name: Desalination
product.description: TAQA operates desalination facilities, focusing on efficient reverse osmosis technology to reduce energy consumption.
